# defectdojo_system_settings (Resource)

Manages DefectDojo's system settings: the configuration of the whole instance. It needs a superuser.

The provider changes only the settings in the configuration. The others keep DefectDojo's values, which the resource reads, so importing the settings and adding the resource change nothing; removing a setting from the configuration leaves its value as it is. A setting someone changes in DefectDojo is changed back by the next apply when it is in the configuration, and otherwise taken over. Manage the settings with one resource only: two would undo each other's changes.

The system settings always exist: creating the resource changes the configured settings, and destroying it only removes it from the Terraform state, leaving the settings as they are.

DefectDojo returns the Slack token, the Microsoft Teams webhook URL and the Jira webhook secret in plain text: they are write-only attributes here, which are never stored, with a version that makes the provider send them. DefectDojo's read-only mode is left out on purpose: while it is on, DefectDojo rejects every change but those of the system settings, so turn it on and off in DefectDojo.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Only the settings in the configuration are managed; the others keep
# DefectDojo's values.
resource "defectdojo_system_settings" "example" {
  enable_deduplication = true
  delete_duplicates    = true
  max_dupes            = 5

  enable_finding_sla       = true
  enable_notify_sla_active = true

  engagement_auto_close      = true
  engagement_auto_close_days = 30

  # Notifications to Slack, also needed by the slack channel of
  # defectdojo_notifications.
  enable_slack_notifications = true
  slack_channel              = "#security"
  slack_token_wo             = var.slack_token
  slack_token_wo_version     = 1
}

variable "slack_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `add_vulnerability_id_to_jira_label` (Boolean) Whether a finding's vulnerability IDs are added to the labels of its Jira issue. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `allow_anonymous_survey_response` (Boolean) Whether anyone with a survey's link can answer it. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `api_expose_error_details` (Boolean) Whether API errors include their details. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `delete_duplicates` (Boolean) Whether DefectDojo deletes the oldest duplicates of a finding beyond `max_dupes`. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `disable_jira_webhook_secret` (Boolean) Whether Jira's webhook calls are accepted without the secret, which DefectDojo discourages. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `disclaimer_notes` (String) A disclaimer shown next to the form for notes. At most 3000 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace, which DefectDojo removes; `""` clears it. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `disclaimer_notifications` (String) A disclaimer added to every notification. At most 3000 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace, which DefectDojo removes; `""` clears it. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `disclaimer_reports` (String) A disclaimer added to reports. At most 5000 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace, which DefectDojo removes; `""` clears it. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `disclaimer_reports_forced` (Boolean) Whether the report disclaimer is added to every report, even when it isn't chosen. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `email_from` (String) The sender address of notification mails. At most 200 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace, which DefectDojo removes; `""` clears it. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `enable_benchmark` (Boolean) Whether benchmarks, such as the OWASP ASVS, are on. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `enable_calendar` (Boolean) Whether the calendar is on. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `enable_checklists` (Boolean) Whether checklists are on. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `enable_cvss3_display` (Boolean) Whether the UI shows CVSS 3 fields. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `enable_cvss4_display` (Boolean) Whether the UI shows CVSS 4 fields. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `enable_deduplication` (Boolean) Whether DefectDojo marks new findings that match an existing finding (by endpoints, CWE and title) as duplicates. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `enable_endpoint_metadata_import` (Boolean) Whether the import of endpoint metadata is on. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `enable_finding_groups` (Boolean) Whether finding groups are on. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `enable_finding_sla` (Boolean) Whether findings get SLA expiration dates. **While it is off, DefectDojo never finishes recalculating SLA dates**, so an SLA configuration whose days changed, and the products using it, stay locked (see `defectdojo_sla_configuration`). Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `enable_github` (Boolean) Whether the GitHub integration is on. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `enable_jira` (Boolean) Whether the Jira integration is on. It is needed to push findings to Jira, not to manage `defectdojo_jira_instance` and `defectdojo_jira_project`. DefectDojo also lists the configuration permissions of Jira instances only while it is on. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `enable_jira_web_hook` (Boolean) Whether DefectDojo accepts Jira's webhook calls, which need the Jira webhook secret (`jira_webhook_secret_wo`) in their URL unless `disable_jira_webhook_secret` is on. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `enable_mail_notifications` (Boolean) Whether notifications can be mailed (the `mail` channel of `defectdojo_notifications`). Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `enable_msteams_notifications` (Boolean) Whether notifications can go to Microsoft Teams (the `msteams` channel of `defectdojo_notifications`). It needs `msteams_url_wo`. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `enable_notify_sla_active` (Boolean) Whether DefectDojo notifies when active findings breach their SLA. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `enable_notify_sla_active_verified` (Boolean) Whether DefectDojo notifies when active, verified findings breach their SLA. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `enable_notify_sla_exponential_backoff` (Boolean) Whether SLA breach notifications back off exponentially (after 1, 2, 4, 8 days, …) rather than coming every day. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `enable_notify_sla_jira_only` (Boolean) Whether SLA breach notifications are sent only for findings with a Jira issue. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `enable_product_grade` (Boolean) Whether products show a grade letter for their overall health. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `enable_product_tag_inheritance` (Boolean) Whether every product passes its tags on to its engagements, tests and findings. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `enable_product_tracking_files` (Boolean) Whether product tracking files are on. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `enable_questionnaires` (Boolean) Whether questionnaires are on. DefectDojo also lists the configuration permissions of questionnaires only while it is on. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `enable_similar_findings` (Boolean) Whether a finding's page lists similar findings, which can be slow. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `enable_slack_notifications` (Boolean) Whether notifications can go to Slack (the `slack` channel of `defectdojo_notifications`). It needs `slack_token_wo`. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `enable_ui_table_based_searching` (Boolean) Whether table headings also sort the current page. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `enable_user_profile_editable` (Boolean) Whether users can edit their profiles. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `enable_webhooks_notifications` (Boolean) Whether notifications can go to webhooks (the `webhooks` channel of `defectdojo_notifications`; see `defectdojo_notification_webhook`). Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `enforce_verified_status` (Boolean) Whether grading, Jira, metrics and reports consider only verified findings. It overrides the three `enforce_verified_status_*` settings. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `enforce_verified_status_jira` (Boolean) Whether only verified findings are pushed to Jira. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `enforce_verified_status_metrics` (Boolean) Whether only verified findings count in metrics, reports and filters. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `enforce_verified_status_product_grading` (Boolean) Whether only verified findings count for a product's grade. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `engagement_auto_close` (Boolean) Whether DefectDojo closes engagements `engagement_auto_close_days` days after their end date. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `engagement_auto_close_days` (Number) The number of days after their end date that engagements are closed when `engagement_auto_close` is on. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `false_positive_history` (Boolean) Whether DefectDojo marks a new finding as a false positive when an equal finding of the product was (experimental; doesn't work with deduplication). Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `filter_string_matching` (Boolean) Whether the UI's filters match text rather than IDs, which is faster. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `jira_labels` (String) The labels of new Jira issues, separated by spaces. At most 200 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace, which DefectDojo removes; `""` clears it. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `jira_minimum_severity` (String) The lowest severity of findings that are pushed to Jira: `Critical`, `High`, `Medium`, `Low`, `Info`, or `""` for all. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `jira_webhook_secret_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The secret that Jira's webhook calls carry in their URL. DefectDojo generates one when it is installed; setting this replaces it, so Jira's webhook URL has to change with it. 1 to 64 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace, which DefectDojo removes. It is write-only: never stored in the plan or state, and Terraform can't detect a change of it, or one made in DefectDojo; it is sent when `jira_webhook_secret_wo_version` changes. Removing both leaves DefectDojo's value: it can't be cleared from Terraform. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later.
- `jira_webhook_secret_wo_version` (Number) The version of `jira_webhook_secret_wo`. The provider sends the value when the version is set or changes.
- `lowercase_character_required` (Boolean) Whether users' passwords need a lowercase letter. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `mail_notifications_to` (String) The address of system-wide notification mails. At most 200 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace, which DefectDojo removes; `""` clears it. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `max_dupes` (Number) The number of duplicates of a finding to keep when `delete_duplicates` is on; `0` deletes them all. DefectDojo can also have no limit (null), which only its UI can set. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `maximum_password_length` (Number) The maximum length of users' passwords, 9 to 48. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `minimum_password_length` (Number) The minimum length of users' passwords (including `defectdojo_user.password_wo`), 9 to 48, and at most `maximum_password_length`. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `msteams_url_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The URL of the Microsoft Teams incoming webhook, which carries its token. at most 400 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace, which DefectDojo removes. It is write-only: never stored in the plan or state, and Terraform can't detect a change of it, or one made in DefectDojo; it is sent when `msteams_url_wo_version` changes. Removing both leaves DefectDojo's value: it can't be cleared from Terraform. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later.
- `msteams_url_wo_version` (Number) The version of `msteams_url_wo`. The provider sends the value when the version is set or changes.
- `non_common_password_required` (Boolean) Whether users' passwords must not be common passwords. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `number_character_required` (Boolean) Whether users' passwords need a digit. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `product_grade_a` (Number) The percentage score a product needs for an A. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `product_grade_b` (Number) The percentage score a product needs for a B. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `product_grade_c` (Number) The percentage score a product needs for a C. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `product_grade_d` (Number) The percentage score a product needs for a D. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `product_grade_f` (Number) The percentage score at or below which a product gets an F. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `retroactive_false_positive_history` (Boolean) Whether the false positive history also marks or unmarks the existing equal findings of the product (experimental; needs `false_positive_history`). Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `risk_acceptance_form_default_days` (Number) The default number of days until a risk acceptance expires. DefectDojo can also have none (null), which only its UI can set. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `risk_acceptance_notify_before_expiration` (Number) How many days before a risk acceptance expires DefectDojo notifies. DefectDojo can also not notify (null), which only its UI can set. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `slack_channel` (String) The Slack channel of system-wide notifications. At most 100 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace, which DefectDojo removes; `""` clears it. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `slack_token_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The token of DefectDojo's Slack app. at most 100 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace, which DefectDojo removes. It is write-only: never stored in the plan or state, and Terraform can't detect a change of it, or one made in DefectDojo; it is sent when `slack_token_wo_version` changes. Removing both leaves DefectDojo's value: it can't be cleared from Terraform. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later.
- `slack_token_wo_version` (Number) The version of `slack_token_wo`. The provider sends the value when the version is set or changes.
- `slack_username` (String) The name DefectDojo posts to Slack as, or `""` for the bot's name. At most 100 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace, which DefectDojo removes; `""` clears it. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `special_character_required` (Boolean) Whether users' passwords need a special character. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `team_name` (String) The name of the team. At most 100 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace, which DefectDojo removes; `""` clears it. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `uppercase_character_required` (Boolean) Whether users' passwords need an uppercase letter. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `url_prefix` (String) The path DefectDojo is served under, when it isn't served at the root. At most 300 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace, which DefectDojo removes; `""` clears it. Read from DefectDojo when not set.
- `webhooks_notifications_timeout` (Number) How many seconds DefectDojo waits for a webhook to answer. Read from DefectDojo when not set.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of the system settings, `1` on every DefectDojo installation.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = defectdojo_system_settings.example
  identity = {
    id = 1
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (Number) ID of the system settings

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The system settings are imported by their numeric ID, which is 1
terraform import defectdojo_system_settings.example 1
```
